subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation and tool-free announce handoffs as the canonical behavior for interrupted subagent completion delivery turns?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session lifecycle semantics and tool availability for an internal delivery turn, which is a maintainer-owned session-state and security-boundary decision even though the implementation looks coherent.

options.title: Accept After Cleanup
options.body: Resolve conflicts, clear lint, and land the PR with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce handoffs as the intended invariant.

options.title: Change The Terminal State
options.body: Ask for a narrower patch if maintainers want interrupted announce deliveries reconciled to a different non-running state than `killed`.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want a larger restart-recovery state model before changing announce delivery semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, clear lint, and land the PR with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce handoffs as the intended invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent restart lifecycle seam work is the closest available history signal for the persisted recovery behavior being changed.
